body:
Problem:
`vim.Range` is documented as 0-indexed and end-exclusive (`[start, end)`). However, `Range:has()` compared inner position against outer end bounds using `cmp_pos.ge`, causing positions located exactly at the end boundary (`col == range.end_col`) or empty ranges to be evaluated as inside the range.

Solution:
Compare inner position against outer end bounds with `cmp_pos.gt` so that the end bound is strictly exclusive for `vim.Pos`.

Fixes #41225
title: fix(range): make Range:has() end-exclusive for vim.Pos

body:
Problem:
CTRL-W commands can enter a split with focusable=false. Only floats are skipped.

Solution:
Skip non-focusable windows, regardless of whether they are floating.

Fixes #29365
title: fix(window): CTRL-W commands enter non-focusable split
